note: Element dictionary. Each element is defined ONCE here and bound by many forms. temporal_type and scope_predicate are what keep same-named concepts legally distinct.

elements.label: Name of establishment
elements.definition: Registered name of the establishment as entered in the entity master.

elements.label: Address of establishment
elements.definition: Decomposed premises address of the establishment.

elements.label: Name of employer
elements.definition: Legal person liable as employer.

elements.label: Constitution of entity
elements.definition: Legal constitution (company, LLP, firm, proprietorship).

elements.label: Permanent Account Number
elements.definition: Income tax PAN of the entity.

elements.label: Tax Deduction Account Number
elements.definition: TAN used for TDS filings.

elements.label: GSTIN
elements.definition: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number for the registered state.

elements.label: Corporate Identity Number
elements.definition: MCA corporate identity number.

elements.label: Labour Identification Number
elements.definition: Shram Suvidha labour identification number.

elements.label: EPF establishment code
elements.definition: EPFO establishment code.

elements.label: ESIC employer code
elements.definition: ESIC employer registration code.

elements.label: PT registration number
elements.definition: State professional tax registration number.

elements.label: Authorised signatory
elements.definition: Person authorised to sign the filing, with designation.

elements.label: Return period
elements.definition: Tax or contribution period the filing covers.

elements.label: Employee name
elements.definition: Name of the individual employee as per employee master.

elements.label: Universal Account Number
elements.definition: EPFO universal account number of the member.

elements.label: ESIC insured person number
elements.definition: Insured person number allotted by ESIC.

elements.label: Employee PAN
elements.definition: PAN of the employee, required for salary TDS reporting.

elements.label: Date of joining
elements.definition: Date the employee joined the establishment.

elements.label: Gender
elements.definition: Gender as recorded in the employee master.

elements.label: Designation
elements.definition: Designation held during the period.

elements.label: Days worked / paid
elements.definition: Number of days for which wages are payable in the wage period.

elements.label: Gross wages
elements.definition: Total of all wage components payable before deductions.
elements.warning: Do NOT conflate with EPF_WAGES / ESI_WAGES / PT_BASIS / TAXABLE_SALARY. Same components, four different statutory bases.

elements.label: EPF wages
elements.definition: Basic plus dearness allowance, restricted to the statutory wage ceiling.

elements.label: ESI wages
elements.definition: Gross wages of employees whose gross does not exceed the ESI coverage ceiling.

elements.label: PT wage basis
elements.definition: Monthly gross wages used to locate the professional tax slab.

elements.label: Taxable salary
elements.definition: Annual salary chargeable to tax after standard deduction.

elements.label: EPF employee contribution
elements.definition: Employee share of provident fund contribution.

elements.label: EPF employer contribution
elements.definition: Employer share of provident fund contribution net of pension diversion.

elements.label: Pension fund contribution
elements.definition: Employer share diverted to the pension scheme.

elements.label: ESI employee contribution
elements.definition: Employee share of ESI contribution.

elements.label: ESI employer contribution
elements.definition: Employer share of ESI contribution.

elements.label: Professional tax deducted
elements.definition: Professional tax deducted from wages in the period.

elements.label: TDS on salary
elements.definition: Tax deducted at source on salary under section 192.

elements.label: TDS on contractor payments
elements.definition: Tax deducted at source under section 194C.

elements.label: Total headcount
elements.definition: Count of persons on the rolls at the end of the wage period.

elements.label: EPF member count
elements.definition: Count of persons who are provident fund members.

elements.label: ESI covered count
elements.definition: Count of persons whose gross wages fall within the ESI ceiling.

elements.label: Workers in hazardous process
elements.definition: Count of workers engaged in a hazardous process.

elements.label: Headcount by gender
elements.definition: Headcount split by gender as recorded.

elements.label: Taxable value of outward supplies
elements.definition: Aggregate taxable value of outward supplies in the tax period.

elements.label: Output CGST
elements.definition: Central GST charged on outward supplies.

elements.label: Output SGST
elements.definition: State GST charged on outward supplies.

elements.label: Output IGST
elements.definition: Integrated GST charged on inter-state outward supplies.

elements.label: Input tax credit - CGST
elements.definition: Eligible central GST input tax credit for the period.

elements.label: Input tax credit - SGST
elements.definition: Eligible state GST input tax credit for the period.

elements.label: Input tax credit - IGST
elements.definition: Eligible integrated GST input tax credit for the period.

elements.label: HSN-wise summary
elements.definition: Taxable value and tax grouped by HSN code.

elements.label: B2B invoice detail
elements.definition: Invoice-level detail of supplies to registered persons.

elements.label: Contractors engaged
elements.definition: Contractors engaged during the period with registration and amounts.

elements.label: Challan / payment references
elements.definition: TRRN, challan and UTR references evidencing statutory remittance.
elements.note: Not derivable from books alone - originates in the banking leg.

elements.label: Salary and wages expense
elements.definition: Salary and wages charged to the profit and loss account.

elements.label: Section 43B payment status
elements.definition: Whether statutory dues were actually paid, and when, for allowability.
elements.note: Cross-domain dependency: an income tax element resolved from labour remittance atoms.
